comment: The claims request parameter is not implemented and discovery says so (claims_parameter_supported=false), which the suite accepts as permitted behaviour.
The conformance clients hold EC keys, so there is no RSA key to sign an RS256 assertion with. Covered from the server side by StandardClientAssertionTests.
No refresh token is issued: the plan's clients do not request offline_access. Refresh tokens have their own tests in RefreshTokenTests.
